title: Glowing sneaker
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <circle cx='43' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#ff4fa3'/>

  <path d='M82 40 Q92 42 94 50 Q94 58 88 62 L82 62 Q90 56 90 50 Q90 44 82 40 Z' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
